description: RAS payload extensions (Part D). Extends RasPayloadSchema with derivedHeadline, hookPotential, facts[], verified, claimRisk, outboundUrls, quoted, attributionLine (all optional/defaulted so RSS payloads stay valid); builds X facts[] per FIX #8; removes the earlier signalOnly->limited change per FIX #2 (do NOT add it); and wires rawToRankItem (X fields from metadata), the collectXPosts({log}) call + dropped sessionNotReady log, and the RankedStory->buildRasPayload handoff in autoNewsToRas.ts. Depends on FEAT-002 (new CollectXResult shape) and FEAT-003 (RankedStory fields: verified/claimRisk/derivedHeadline/outboundUrls/quoted/hookPotential, RankInputItem X fields).
steps: src/mastra/schemas/handoff.ts — extend RasPayloadSchema additively (all optional/defaulted): derivedHeadline z.string().optional(), hookPotential z.number().min(0).max(10).optional(), facts z.array(z.object({ claim: z.string(), sourceUrl: z.string(), sourceType: z.enum(['rss','x','primary']) })).default([]), verified z.boolean().default(false), claimRisk z.enum(['low','medium','high']).default('low'), outboundUrls z.array(z.string()).default([]), quoted z.object({ text, author_handle: z.string().nullable(), url, at }).nullable().default(null), attributionLine z.string().nullable().default(null). Existing RSS payloads must still validate unchanged.

src/mastra/lib/ras/payload.ts — buildRasPayload accepts the extra inputs from prepareForHandoff: the selected RankedStory (for derivedHeadline, hookPotential, claimRisk, verified, outboundUrls, quoted) and the X authorHandle + isXOnly flag. Build facts[] as the authoritative claim set: RSS/fact-pack items keep their keyFact/figure-derived facts with sourceType 'primary' when a primary source exists else 'rss'. FIX #8: for X items pin facts[] to [{ claim: derivedHeadline, sourceUrl: <post url or first outbound>, sourceType }] PLUS one entry per resolved outbound URL (sourceType 'primary' if it points to a primary source, else 'x'); drop any vague 'claim sentences' extraction. attributionLine = 'per @<handle> on X' ONLY when isXOnly (no corroborating RSS), null otherwise. Prefer derivedHeadline over the raw title for X items. Keep RSS backward-compatible (new fields optional/empty where N/A).

src/mastra/lib/workflow/autoNewsToRas.ts — extend rawToRankItem to populate the RankInputItem X fields from raw.metadata (isX = raw.sourceType==='x', isReply, isRepost, outboundUrls, quoted, authorHandle, engagementRaw, accountMedianLikes, accountMedianReposts, accountStatus default 'candidate', isOfficialAccount, accountCredibilityScore, plus carried LLM meaning fields where used) — default empty for RSS. Change the X collect call to collectXPosts({ log: opts.log }) (keep the surrounding try/catch — NFR-1) and DROP the sessionNotReady field from the x.collected log. FIX #2 (payload): do NOT add '|| raw.signalOnly' to the `limited` computation — keep it exactly !!(args.raw?.paywalled || args.raw?.factPackLimited || args.raw?.viaFallback). In prepareForHandoff pass the selected RankedStory (and its raw) into buildRasPayload so derivedHeadline/verified/claimRisk/outboundUrls/quoted/hookPotential and the X authorHandle/isXOnly flow through; trust is carried by verified/claimRisk, NOT by collapsing X into factPackLimited.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck` passes with the extended RasPayloadSchema, buildRasPayload facts[], and the autoNewsToRas wiring.

An X-only story produces a NON-empty facts[] with sourceType 'x' (or 'primary' for a primary outbound) and attributionLine 'per @handle on X'; an RSS story leaves the X fields empty/default and still validates.
`limited` is NOT forced true by signalOnly (verified by tests/ras/payloadX.test.ts in FEAT-005).
`npm run test` — existing RAS suites (handoff.test.ts, pick.test.ts, copywriter.test.ts) still pass.
findings:
DONE. Verified: `npm run typecheck` exit 0; `npm run test` 88/88 pass (handoff.test.ts, pick.test.ts, copywriter.test.ts all green; existing RSS payloads validate unchanged).

== schemas/handoff.ts — RasPayloadSchema NEW optional/defaulted fields (final names/shapes for FEAT-005 payloadX.test.ts) ==
All additive so existing RSS payloads validate unchanged:
- derivedHeadline: z.string().optional()
- hookPotential: z.number().min(0).max(10).optional()
- facts: z.array(z.object({ claim: z.string(), sourceUrl: z.string(), sourceType: z.enum(['rss','x','primary']) })).default([])
- verified: z.boolean().default(false)
- claimRisk: z.enum(['low','medium','high']).default('low')
- outboundUrls: z.array(z.string()).default([])
- quoted: z.object({ text, author_handle: z.string().nullable(), url, at }).nullable().default(null)
- attributionLine: z.string().nullable().default(null)
(existing fields headline..factPackLimited unchanged).

== lib/ras/payload.ts — buildRasPayload signature (for FEAT-005) ==
export function buildRasPayload(args: { item: RankInputItem; factPack: FactPack; image: { imageLocalPath; imageSourceUrl; imageAttribution; under1080 }; suggestedCaptionAngle?: string; llmCopy?: EditorialCopy | null; extraSourceUrls?: string[]; story?: RankedStory | null; authorHandle?: string | null; isXOnly?: boolean }): RasPayload.
NEW private helper buildFacts({ isX, factPack, item, derivedHeadline, outboundUrls, verified }): Fact[] where Fact = RasPayload['facts'][number].
FIX #8 behaviour: for an X item facts[] = [{ claim: derivedHeadline (or factPack.headline/title), sourceUrl: post url (or first outbound when no post url), sourceType }] PLUS one entry per resolved outbound URL (sourceType 'primary' when the story is `verified`, else 'x'); deduped by sourceUrl; the vague claim-sentence extraction is dropped for X. For RSS/fact-pack items each grounded keyFact becomes a fact pinned to factPack.primarySource with sourceType 'primary' when a primary source exists, else the first sourceUrl with sourceType 'rss'. attributionLine = 'per @<handle> on X' ONLY when isX && isXOnly && handle present, else null. X items prefer derivedHeadline over the raw first-line title for headline/serifHeadline. RSS leaves facts grounded to its own sources and all X-signal extras empty/default.

== lib/workflow/autoNewsToRas.ts ==
rawToRankItem now maps the X-signal fields from raw.metadata when raw.sourceType==='x' (isX=true, isReply, isRepost, outboundUrls, quoted, authorHandle, engagementRaw {likes,reposts,replies,views all defaulted 0}, accountMedianLikes/Reposts (default 0), accountStatus (default 'candidate'), isOfficialAccount (default false), accountCredibilityScore (default 0), plus carried LLM meaning fields isPrimarySource/claimRisk/derivedHeadline/hookPotential when present); RSS items return the base item with the X fields absent (empty/default).
collectXPosts call is collectXPosts({ log: opts.log, now: opts.now }) inside the existing try/catch (NFR-1); the x.collected log no longer carries sessionNotReady.
FIX #2 (payload): `limited` in prepareForHandoff stays EXACTLY !!(args.raw?.paywalled || args.raw?.factPackLimited || args.raw?.viaFallback) — '|| raw.signalOnly' was NOT added (trust is carried by verified/claimRisk, not by collapsing X into factPackLimited).
prepareForHandoff gained optional rankedStory?: RankedStory|null + isXOnly?: boolean and threads story/authorHandle/isXOnly into buildRasPayload so derivedHeadline/verified/claimRisk/outboundUrls/quoted/hookPotential + attribution flow through. pickPostableCandidate passes the ranked story `r` and computes isXOnly via a new private isXOnlyStory(r, rawById) = X item whose outboundUrls do NOT match any RSS source URL in the run (uses exported urlKey + matchOutboundToRss from lib/ranking/rankStories). Non-X stories are never X-only.

NOTE for FEAT-005 payloadX.test.ts: `limited` is NOT forced true by signalOnly. An X-only story yields a non-empty facts[] (sourceType 'x', or 'primary' when verified + outbound) and attributionLine 'per @handle on X'; an RSS story leaves facts grounded to its sources, verified=false, claimRisk 'low', outboundUrls [], quoted null, attributionLine null.
